g: (Malta) A ring-shaped Maltese unleavened loaf often filled and made into sandwiches.
(slang, gaming, transitive) To defeat (an opponent) on the first turn of a turn-based game.
He must have made some kind of deal with fate if he managed to FTK her!
(Internet slang, vulgar, initialism) For the motherfucking win.
An instance of sending files via FTP (the File Transfer Protocol).
Each batch is an FTP. The log tracking them is on the dashboard.
(computing, transitive) To transfer using File Transfer Protocol.
We FTP the whole dataset to the customer after we've scanned it to ensure that no restricted data is left inside it.
(bacteriology) A gene found in E. coli used for septum formation in cell division.
